subject: Regional SI deployment constraints sync — EU & APAC

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Regional SI deployment constraints sync — EU & APAC

Lena —

Great to meet you at AI Partners Summit last week. BlueOak sounded like a strong fit for a regional SI partnership, and we'd like to align on a couple of constraints upfront so we can scope a joint go-to-market and delivery model. Top-line asks: 

- Confirm whether BlueOak runs customer-managed VPCs in EU regions (single-tenant) or prefers multi-tenant setups.
- Typical data residency patterns for EU customers (do you route logs/metrics outside region? do you support customer KMS?)
- APAC coverage: which countries do you have local deployment experience in, and any known regulatory blockers (e.g., in-country hosting requirements)?
- Contracting: do you require a reseller addendum / SOW that references local data processing? Any standard clauses you ask vendors to accept?

I've attached our quick regional requirements brief for SIs (redwood-si-region-requirements.pdf). Would you be open to a 30-min sync next week with BlueOak's delivery + legal leads? Proposed slots: Tue 6/9 9:30–10:00 PT or Wed 6/10 11:00–11:30 PT.

If you can share BlueOak's short dataflow matrix ahead of time, that will help us prep.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachment: redwood-si-region-requirements.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
From: Lena Novak <lena.novak@blueoak.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kyle Mercer <kyle.mercer@blueoak.com>, partners@blueoak.com
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 17:04:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Regional SI deployment constraints sync — EU & APAC

Hi Alex,

Thanks — excited to follow up. Quick answers and context: 

- BlueOak typically deploys customer workloads into a customer-managed VPC when the customer requires strict isolation (common in EU regulated sectors). We also operate a managed offering for mid-market customers where we host in a dedicated tenant but still honor regional data residency controls.
- For EU customers we keep logs and telemetry in-region by default when requested; we can integrate with customer KMS (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK) but need a short security addendum for key access patterns.
- APAC: we have local delivery teams in SG, JP, and AU. Data residency blockers happen most often in CN and certain public sector contracts in AU — we can scope on a case basis.
- Contracting: our legal team will ask for a DP Processing Addendum and a statement that support telemetry is limited to region unless explicitly permitted. We can share our standard reseller/SOW templates.

Attaching a concise dataflow matrix for EU customers (blueoak-eu-dataflow-matrix.xlsx). I'd like to include our Legal lead Kyle Mercer's counsel on the call; copying him. Tue 6/9 9:30 PT works for us if you can confirm.

Best,
Lena Novak
Head of Strategic Partnerships | BlueOak Systems
lena.novak@blueoak.com | +44 20 7946 0821

Attachment: blueoak-eu-dataflow-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional SI deployment constraints sync — EU & APAC

Lena / Kyle —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. Confirming Tue 6/9 9:30 PT / 17:30 BST for a 30-min sync — invite sent. Agenda I'll suggest: 1) BlueOak deployment patterns (isolation, KMS), 2) contracting expectations and dataproc addendum scope, 3) a minimal mutual action plan to pilot one EU customer, and 4) who owns which public-facing collateral.

Prep notes for BlueOak legal: our standard approach is to offer either: (A) Hosted Redwood API with customer-requested region pinning + optional customer KMS for encryption-at-rest, or (B) Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) where the customer signs a platform licensing agreement. For pilots we often recommend Hosted + VPC isolation + strict telemetry filters — that minimizes onboarding time.

Quick asks for internal ops/legal alignment (looping Karthik + Marissa): 
- Karthik: can you run a short feasibility check on option A vs B for the pilot (rough effort estimate and infra constraints for EU pinned hosting + CMEK)?
- Marissa: can you draft a short dataproc addendum template that covers logs/telemetry residency and KMS integration notes?

Linking a draft MAP I started here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3SI-Joint-MAP — please add comments before EOD Tue so we can finalize during the call.

Cheers,
Alex
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Alex / Marissa / Soojin —

Quick internal summary and next steps after review of the matrix: 

1) Option A (Hosted with region pinning + CMEK) — feasible for pilot in eu-west-1 / eu-central-1. Work estimate: 2 weeks infra engineering (batching rules, env pinning), 1 week security appraisal for CMEK integration. Dependencies: KMS access patterns from BlueOak legal and test keys.

2) Option B (Private VPC/on-prem) — larger lift: ~6–8 weeks including deployment automation and onboarding scripts; recommended for customers requiring on-prem/air-gapped.

3) Telemetry/logs: we can toggle telemetry export by deployment; need dataproc addendum to lock region-by-default and to define emergency support access. Marissa — can you share a first pass addendum by EOD Wed?

4) Action items: 
- Marissa: dataproc addendum draft (EOD Wed)
- Alex: run call and confirm BlueOak legal attendees (done)
- Soojin: prepare a short runbook for pilot (access, certs, validation tests) — aim for Fri next week.

I'll stand by for the call notes and will join the sync Tue 17:30 BST.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Product Manager | Redwood Inference
